data.body: Update 2026-06-01: workflow-stability v4 merged to main (PR1 #524 -> staged -> PR2 #527 -> main, a44d9d1ac2). The 6 failures in this script are PRE-EXISTING and were NOT introduced by v4 (confirmed identical on the pre-W2 dispatcher). v4 DID modify verify-session-provenance.sh (W4: removed the blanket A3a head==sha exclusion). Re-verify whether these all-provenanced-fixture failures persist post-v4 and whether they are a local-env artifact (the script lives in tests/workflows/, not the tests/scripts/ Script Tests CI job) or a genuine verifier bug. Still open.
